summary_1line: Bharata humbly visits sage Bharadwaja, denies any role in Rama’s exile, and asks where Rama lives so he can bring him back.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata, dressed in simple silk and leaving his army behind, walks on foot through the forest toward Bharadwaja’s leaf-thatched hermitage with Vasishtha.
The aged sage Bharadwaja rises from his seat as disciples bring ritual water while Bharata bows deeply before him in the forest hermitage.
With tear-filled eyes and folded hands, Bharata declares before the sage that he had no part in Rama’s exile and seeks only to bring his brother home.
